extra_quotes: We characterize our SAW resonator using a vector network analyzer (VNA, Keysight P5000A).
To assess the power handling, we use a power amplifier (Amplifier Research, 150A 100C) with reference signal s from a function generator (Tektronix, AFG3102C) to directly drive our SAW device.
We use Keysight B1505 to measure the DC isolation (breakdown) voltage between the input and output IDTs
DC-AC power conversion is first demonstrated using our SAW devices, where the load resistor is directly connected to the output IDT
DC-DC conversion is also demonstrated by connecting a diode rectifier to the output IDT , despite efficiency degrading to 52.7%.
The DC-DC conversion efficiency is significantly lower than DC-AC conversion efficiency; it is a result of diode forward voltage drop, and the varying impedance seen by the SAW resonator.
